cards.name: Launch Vacation Bible School
cards.description: Children explore God's redemption plan through the Junkyard Redemption theme, based on Ephesians 1:7. Activities include snacks, crafts, and games.

hours.text: Monday–Thursday: drop-off begins 5:30 PM; meals begin 5:45 PM; VBS begins 6:30 PM; pickup begins 8:15 PM. Sunday kickoff: 10:00 AM. Friday commencement service: 6:00 PM; food and inflatables to follow.

cards.review_notes: The event's calendar header begins July 12 at 10:15 AM, while its detailed schedule gives the Sunday kickoff as 10:00 AM; the detailed schedule is used. Eligibility is stated as 'PreK4 to Rising 7th Grade'; rising explicitly modifies the upper endpoint. Meals are evening meals, so lunch is left null. The hours end represents when pickup begins, not a stated final pickup deadline.
